name: Prince Panic DX
source:
Main heroine is still in training to become a maid of Alstroemeria Castle. DX version increases number of characters for capture to seven and includes bonus content.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主人公仍在接受成为六出花城女仆的训练。DX版将可攻略角色增加至七人，并收录了额外内容。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
